title: Atlas · Fri Nov 20 · 2:30pm
big_picture: a broad AI sell-off. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910 and the Nasdaq 5.3% to 22,618, erasing its 2026 gain; the S&P and Dow closed in a correction ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/nasdaq-dives-1-261-points-as-anthropic-ai-stocks-sink-stock-market-today), [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/nasdaq-plunges-5-on-friday-ending-worst-week-since-april-202611202111)). Reported triggers, in order of weight: Reuters, citing two unnamed sources, said SEC enforcement staff are examining Nvidia's accounting (rumour: not confirmed by the SEC or Nvidia), and Nvidia fell 14.0% to 125.53 ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4675286-nvidia-tumbles-as-sec-probe-explores-accounting-issues-report), [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/20/nvidia-stock-plunge-wipes-out-nearly-usd500-billion-in-one-day-as-sec-reportedly-probes-its-accounting/)); Anthropic (ANT) gave back about 8.5% a day after closing its first day at $97.17, up 17% from the $83 IPO price ([Invezz](https://invezz.com/nz/news/2026/11/19/anthropics-ant-closes-at-dollar9717-up-17percent-on-its-first-day-of-trading/), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/anthropic-ipo-live-anthropic-stock-drops-after-first-day-of-trading-143300513.html)); and the Financial Times reported TSMC and Samsung paused some chip shipments to Chinese customers as a new US export rule took effect ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/news/tsmc-samsung-suspend-chip-shipments-china/)). Asia was weak first: Taiwan closed its worst week since 1991 ([24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/20/amd-stock-drops-another-7-0-before-the-bell-and-taiwan-semiconductor-slides-4-2-as-nasdaq-futures-fall-1-6-after-asias-chip-selloff/)). Sources differ on exact closes; I use the price file. Money went to defensives: the staples ETF (XLP) rose 0.7% while the tech ETF (XLK) fell 7.1%. Headline or business: the SEC item is a headline so far (no filing, nothing confirmed), but the China-shipment pause is a business effect on TSMC and Samsung. Taylor, your lesson L5 (crowd and easy-money signs) and L1 (big run plus bubble talk) both speak to a week like this; I did not count a test because no company report was involved today.
urgent: your Micron CDR (MU.TO) sits on a stock that fell hard today. Micron (MU) closed 594.51 USD, -13.9% on the day and -23.6% in five days, which is under the 650 line (its Nov 5 low) that I had named as the kill line for the AI-trade view ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4675351-tech-retreat-takes-micron-down-14?feed_item_type=news), [FX Leaders](https://www.fxleaders.com/news/2026/11/20/micron-stock-tests-the-last-support-at-600-is-the-memory-rally-losing-momentum/)). MU.TO itself closed 30.13 CAD, -2.0% in the price file; that gap to the US move is not explained and I would check a live quote. Micron's next report is Dec 17 (per Yahoo Finance via search, not in my files). Taylor, I am not telling you what to do; this is the fact.
